Simulate buying and selling Euro / US Dollar (EUR/USD) with $100,000 in virtual cash. Charts and prices are for education only — no real money, no brokerage relationship.

Published by TradeHQ, created by Anuga Weerasinghe. Publisher background and editorial approach. No independent professional review is claimed; any recorded source-check scope appears on the page.

What Euro / US Dollar is

EUR/USD expresses the number of US dollars per euro. A rise from 1.10 to 1.12 means the euro buys more dollars in that quotation. An ECB reference rate is a published reference observation, not a guaranteed executable broker quote.

Reference facts
Asset Class: Forex
Pip Value: Variable
How to practise it here

EUR/USD moves on ECB and Fed policy divergence. Compare dated ECB and Federal Reserve releases with separately sourced exchange-rate observations. A coincident move does not establish causation. (Educational simulation only — not financial advice.)

Asset-specific worksheet (hypothetical)

For arithmetic only, translate EUR 1,000 at hypothetical USD-per-EUR rates of 1.10 and 1.12. The results are USD 1,100 and USD 1,120 before costs. Reversing the quotation requires division rather than reusing those multiplications.

Why learners study Euro / US Dollar

EUR/USD quotes dollars per euro. The pair offers a worksheet for separating exchange-rate arithmetic from hypotheses about ECB and Federal Reserve policy; policy differences alone do not determine a future rate.

What tends to move Euro / US Dollar

Decisions and statements from the European Central Bank and the US Federal Reserve, along with inflation and employment data from both regions, are the main drivers.

Euro / US Dollar: practice versus a real account

Retail forex is commonly traded with high leverage, which can magnify losses quickly. TradeHQ does not implement leverage. Express a chosen hypothetical price move in account currency and distinguish this spot practice from a leveraged real account.

Common questions about trading Euro / US Dollar
How do I learn Forex trading for free? — Use a $100,000 demo account to trade the EUR/USD pair. Compare session schedules as a learning exercise. Practice data does not reproduce actual session liquidity or execution.
What is a free forex simulator for beginners? — TradeHQ offers EUR/USD practice with $100K virtual cash. Use it for currency-pair arithmetic and pip calculations; simulated charts do not reproduce actual session liquidity.
How to practice forex trading without money in Sri Lanka? — TradeHQ is free for students in Sri Lanka and worldwide. Practice EUR/USD and GBP/USD with simulated charts — no deposit or signup required.
What factors can affect EUR/USD? — ECB and Federal Reserve policy, inflation, employment data, growth expectations and broader risk conditions can affect EUR/USD. No single release guarantees a particular currency move.
A practice checklist for Euro / US Dollar
Check whether an ECB or Fed announcement falls within your window.
Note whether you are trading during the London–New York overlap.
Calculate what a 100-pip move means in account currency before entry.
